semiconductor_relevance: High — Napson Corporation specializes in measurement systems and software for silicon wafers and flat panel displays, which are critical in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Napson Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells advanced measurement systems and software tailored for silicon wafer and flat panel display production. Their product offerings include various resistivity and sheet resistance measurement instruments, which are essential for quality control in semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: NC-100PV Non-contact Inline measurement module for Solar cell silicon wafer
Cresbox Semi-automatic four point probe sheet resistance/resistivity measurement
EC-80SCAN Non-contact resistivity / thickness measurement instrument

regional_presence.China: Quatek is the exclusive distributor of Napson in China, indicating a strategic partnership for sales and support.
